sys_script_fix.description: Post-import remediation for the x_casemgmt scoped application. Completes the four pieces of wiring an Update Set commit cannot perform for itself, because each is produced by a platform business rule and the commit engine applies payloads with business rules suppressed: Defect C (physical case_task/case_party tables, their fields and all seven choice lists - DDL comes from the after-insert business rule 'Synch Dictionary and Table' on sys_db_object); Defect E (auto-number default_value javascript:global.getNextObjNumberPadded(); on x_casemgmt_case.number plus maximum_digits=7 on the counters); Defect 7 (service_id on the two sys_ws_definition records); Defect 9 (the 27 sys_security_acl_role links plus a GlideSecurityManager security-cache flush). Body is scripts/post_import_remediation.js verbatim. Runs in GLOBAL scope because every table it writes denies cross-scope writes and GlideTableDescriptor/GlideSecurityManager are unavailable to a scoped caller. Fully idempotent: every insert is lookup-guarded and every scalar write is difference-guarded. Auto-executed by the Business Rule 'x_casemgmt Post-Import Bootstrap'; also runnable by hand from System Definition > Fix Scripts > Run Fix Script. Emits gs.info lines prefixed X_CASEMGMT_REMEDIATION| and a final SUMMARY| line carrying verified=true|false.
sys_script_fix.name: x_casemgmt Post-Import Remediation
